title: Pure A-to-Z
summary: The ABC, XYZ and A-to-Z Union cards with generic staples. Every monster is a LIGHT Machine Normal or Union monster that equips from the hand, Deck, GY or banishment and Contact Fuses from the field or GY without Polymerization.

summary.title: Starters
points: Union Hangar searches a LIGHT Machine Union on activation, then equips a different Union from the Deck whenever a Union is Normal or Special Summoned.

Union Activation sends a LIGHT Machine Normal or Union monster from the hand or Deck to the GY to search one with the same ATK, pairing X-Head Cannon with B-Buster Drake or Z-Zillion Tank with A-Assault Core.
X-Cross Cannon Special Summons itself while you control a LIGHT Machine Fusion or Union and equips any Union from the Deck to itself, locking the Extra Deck to LIGHT monsters for the turn.

summary.title: Opening: Union Hangar or X-Cross Cannon
steps: Activate Union Hangar to search B-Buster Drake, Normal Summon it, and use Hangar to equip Union Driver from the Deck.
Banish Union Driver while equipped to equip X-Cross Cannon or Y-Yare Head from the Deck, then Special Summon the equipped monster.
Contact Fuse a LIGHT Machine with Y-Yare Head or Z-Zillion Tank into Union Controller to search Union Activation or Unauthorized Reactivation and summon another Union from the hand.

Link or Contact Fuse off A-Assault Core, B-Buster Drake and C-Crush Wyvern to trigger their GY effects, searching, recovering and Special Summoning more Unions before banishing A, B and C for ABC-Dragon Buster.

summary.title: Contact Fusion Climb
summary.text: Y-Yare Head equips a Level 4 LIGHT Machine from the hand or GY on Special Summon, and Z-Zillion Tank equips a banished one, recycling Unions banished for ABC-Dragon Buster. X-Cross Cannon, Y-Yare Head and Z-Zillion Tank Contact Fuse into XYZ-Hyper Dragon Cannon, which can banish itself to Special Summon X-Head Cannon, Y-Dragon Head and Z-Metal Tank from the Deck or GY for XYZ-Dragon Cannon, then combine with ABC-Dragon Buster into A-to-Z-Dragon Buster Cannon.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: ABC-Dragon Buster discards a card to banish any card on the field on either turn, and tributes itself on the opponent's turn to Special Summon three banished LIGHT Machine Unions.
A-to-Z-Dragon Buster Cannon discards a card to negate any Spell, Trap or monster activation, and can banish itself to summon both ABC-Dragon Buster and XYZ-Dragon Cannon back.
XYZ-Hyper Dragon Cannon discards to destroy a card on the opponent's turn, while Silhouhatte Rabbit provides an extra Link-2 disruption option.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Unauthorized Reactivation is a Quick-Play that equips any Machine Union from the hand or Deck, giving the equipped monster protection or putting a missing ABC piece in rotation.
XYZ Combine Special Summons X-Head Cannon, Y-Dragon Head or Z-Metal Tank from the Deck whenever a Union is banished, and returns a Fusion to the Extra Deck to summon two banished materials.
Union Scramble Special Summons up to three banished LIGHT Machine Normal or Union monsters on either turn.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The page's combo lines splash a Therion engine and non-archetype Extra Deck monsters that this pure LIGHT Machine Union build leaves out.

allow.Unauthorized Reactivation: Named for the Machina, but it's generic Union support: it equips any Machine Union from the hand or Deck.
allow.Silhouhatte Rabbit: Link-2 endboard piece that searches Continuous Trap monsters and triggers quick disruptions.

main: A-Assault Core
Union for a LIGHT Machine: the equipped monster is unaffected by opposing monster effects. Sent from the field to the GY: adds another Union from the GY.
B-Buster Drake
Union for a LIGHT Machine: shields it from Spell effects. Sent from the field to the GY: searches a Union from the Deck.
C-Crush Wyvern
Union for a LIGHT Machine: shields it from Trap effects. Sent from the field to the GY: Special Summons a Union from the hand.
X-Cross Cannon
Special Summons itself while you control a LIGHT Machine Fusion or Union, and equips a Union from the Deck to itself; only LIGHT monsters from the Extra Deck that turn.
Y-Yare Head
Special Summoned: equips a Level 4 LIGHT Machine from the hand or GY to itself. Union for any Machine.
Z-Zillion Tank
Special Summoned: equips one of your banished Level 4 LIGHT Machines, so Unions come back after a contact Fusion. Union for any Machine.
Union Driver
Level 5 Union for any face-up monster; banish it while equipped to equip a Level 4 Union from the Deck instead.
Union Pilot
Level 5 Union: returns to the hand to equip a banished Union, then Special Summons itself.
X-Head Cannon
Normal Monster for XYZ-Dragon Cannon, and a Union Activation pick at 1800 ATK.
Y-Dragon Head
Union for X-Head Cannon, and one of XYZ-Dragon Cannon's materials.
Z-Metal Tank
Union for X-Head Cannon or Y-Dragon Head, and the last XYZ-Dragon Cannon material.
Union Activation
Sends a LIGHT Machine Normal or Union monster to the GY to search one with the same ATK; from the GY, after three LIGHT Machines arrive at once, searches and Normal Summons a 3000+ ATK monster.
Union Hangar
Field Spell: searches a LIGHT Machine Union, then equips a different Union from the Deck whenever a Union is summoned.
Unauthorized Reactivation
Quick-Play: equips a Machine Union from the hand or Deck to your Machine.
XYZ Combine
When a Union is banished, summons X-Head Cannon, Y-Dragon Head or Z-Metal Tank from the Deck; returns a Fusion to bring two of them back from banishment.
Union Scramble
Special Summons up to three banished LIGHT Machine Normal or Union monsters; from the GY, returns one to the hand.
extra: Contact Fusion of A, B and C from the field or GY: discards to banish any card on either turn, and on the opponent's turn splits back into three Unions.
Contact Fusion of X-Cross, Y-Yare and Z-Zillion: discards to destroy a card on the opponent's turn; banishes itself to summon the materials of ABC-Dragon Buster or XYZ-Dragon Cannon.
Contact Fusion of a LIGHT Machine with Y-Yare Head or Z-Zillion Tank: searches a Spell/Trap that mentions Union monsters, and summons a Union from the hand each turn.
Contact Fusion of X-Head Cannon, Y-Dragon Head and Z-Metal Tank: discards to destroy a card. Half of A-to-Z.
ABC-Dragon Buster + XYZ-Dragon Cannon: discards to negate a Spell, Trap or monster effect, and splits back into both on either turn.
Link-2: sets an Illusion or Continuous Trap monster from Deck and triggers it on the opponent's turn for quick disruption.
